insert: When the outcome tracks a figure and also names one of these second sides of the same bet, the two are one bet seen from two sides, not several things with none the main one: ask the figure, and list that second side in not_judged. The second sides are: the share of the figure that one kind makes up (a bank's total lending for the year with the share that is commercial lending; a drug maker's total sales for the year with the part its largest medicine makes up); whether supply stays short of demand beside a figure that measures that supply or its growth (a steel mill's tonnes shipped in the year with whether supply stays short of demand; a fertilizer maker's tonnes produced in the year with whether fertilizer supply stays short of demand); and whether capacity keeps pace with the demand that figure measures (a utility's power demand for the year with whether its generating capacity keeps pace; a city's water demand for the year with whether its treatment capacity keeps pace). In each example the first is the question. When the outcome tracks the share itself, with the total only as its base, the share is the question: a bank's commercial share of its lending for the year, or a carmaker's electric share of the cars it sells in the year, is asked as that share.
